verdict.rationale: llama.cpp documents LLM inference and a VLM session in the CLI. Community users confirm hands-on multimodal use with Gemma-3 via llama-mtmd-cli, so LLMs and vision models are covered. missing for 10: evidence of support for hundreds of distinct architectures, MoE model support, embedding model support, an official supported-models list.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run hundreds of different model architectures including LLMs, MoE, multi-modal, and embedding models

citations.quote: using llama-mtmd-cli with quantized multimodal models like Gemma-3
